proposals.title: Cannes : un rayonnement international qui ne s'arrête jamais
facts: Cannes is again finalist in 2026 World Travel Awards world-leading festival and event destination category
Cannes won in this category in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025
City of Cannes announced Nov 3 the voting extension until Nov 9; 2026 winner is not yet announced
proposals.angle: International prestige and lively year-round Riviera setting for prospective overseas buyers; do not claim 2026 victory or property capital appreciation

proposals.title: Cannes 2027 : Béjart Ballet Lausanne, une soirée d'exception
facts: Two Ballet Lausanne performances at Cannes Palais des Festivals on July 10 2027 17:00 and 21:00
Programme includes Le Sacre du printemps, Béjart et nous, Boléro; marks Maurice Béjart centenary and 40th anniversary of troupe
Official ticket sales opened on Nov 4 2026
proposals.angle: World-class arts available locally as a marker of life on the Riviera, not an event that has already happened

proposals.title: Un réveillon face à la baie de Cannes : drones et feu d'artifice
facts: Cannes tourism official published New Year's Eve bay programme with 5-minute drone show then 15 minutes of fireworks
Theme references the Cannes Film Festival's 80th edition
Official event listing last updated on 2026-11-02
proposals.angle: Aspirational winter Riviera evenings and all-season seaside living, not a repeated unchanged holiday calendar

linkedin.fr: Cannes ne se résume pas à l’été. Pour la Saint-Sylvestre 2026, la Ville annonce un réveillon gratuit sur la baie : 5 minutes de drones lumineux suivies de 15 minutes de feux d’artifice, autour de la 80e édition du Festival de Cannes. Un rendez-vous face à la mer qui illustre l’art de vivre sur la Riviera, même en hiver. En raison des travaux de la Croisette, les organisateurs recommandent l’esplanade Favre Lebret. Programme officiel : https://www.palaisdesfestivals.com/offres/feu-dartifice-du-nouvel-an-show-de-drones-cannes-fr-3807135/ #Cannes #CotedAzur #FrenchRiviera #ArtDeVivre
linkedin.en: Cannes is more than a summer destination. For New Year’s Eve 2026, the city is planning a free display above the bay: five minutes of illuminated drones followed by fifteen minutes of fireworks, with a theme honouring the 80th Cannes Film Festival. It is a glimpse of the French Riviera’s year-round appeal. Due to ongoing Croisette works, organisers recommend viewing from Esplanade Favre Lebret. Official programme: https://www.palaisdesfestivals.com/offres/feu-dartifice-du-nouvel-an-show-de-drones-cannes-fr-3807135/ #Cannes #FrenchRiviera #Lifestyle #RealEstate
